## MAGISTECH 2026

A Two-Day Tech Fest Conglomeration bringing together the technical festivals of all 11 departments of MGIT under one umbrella.

## About the Event

Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Hyderabad, is proud to hostMAGISTECH 2026 – A National-Level Technical Symposium and Two-Day Tech Fest Conglomerationon16th and 17th October 2026.
MAGISTECH 2026 celebrates the spirit of technology, innovation, creativity, collaboration and youthful enthusiasm. The event provides an excellent platform for students to showcase their technical competencies, exchange ideas, explore emerging technologies and interact with peers from engineering institutions across the country.
